children: BHP Group Ltd Sponsored American Depositary Receipt Repr 2 Shs (ASX:BHP) declared a USD 0.99 final dividend and raised Escondida concentrator capex to $5.4–6.3B as Barclays sees easing budget risk, while CCO Rag Udd will depart and Citi highlights copper pipeline focus over uranium growth.
: BHP (BHP) declared a final dividend of USD 0.99/share for year ended June 30, 2026. Record date: Sept 4, 2026. Payment date: Sept 23, 2026. Australian holders can elect NZD, GBP or USD.
: BHP (BHP) raised Escondida concentrator capex 14% to $5.4B–$6.3B for FY26 due to larger scope; Barclays says budget risk for the new concentrator has eased.
: BHP: Chief Commercial Officer Rag Udd will leave end of January 2027, per Bloomberg and internal memo; he’s stepping down to pursue an opportunity outside the company.
